policy.description: R2 is an onboarding exception where unattended Sweep may succeed. All-Sweep remains a negative-control diagnostic for R3 through R25; it is not a birthday-release gate. Production-routed intended/feasibility strategies must survive at least 80% of their seed set.
policy.intendedProfile: Production-routed dispatch comparator with round-appropriate automation and declared loadout; human playtest evidence remains a separate gate.
